I fixed it. The `.mb-2` margin in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed from `0.5rem` to `0.75rem`.

The extra 0.25rem is 4px on desktop. It pushed down the price and button in the two cards with star ratings ("Special Item" and "Popular Item"). Everything below them, including the footer, moved down by the same amount. On phone the shift added up to 8px.

I put it back to `0.5rem`. I re-ran the visual tests and both desktop and phone now match the baselines (2 passed, 0 changed), so I didn't approve or change any baselines.

STATUS: DONE
